repo.description:
### Impact

When a malicious user creates a calendar event with a crafted attachment that links to a download link of a file on the same Nextcloud server, the file would be downloaded without the user confirming the action.

### Patches

It is recommended that the Calendar app is upgraded to 4.7.17 or 5.2.4

### Workarounds

* Disable app Calendar

### References

* [HackerOne](https://hackerone.com/reports/3112033)
* [PullRequest](https://github.com/nextcloud/calendar/pull/6971)

### For more information

If you have any questions or comments about this advisory:

* Create a post in [nextcloud/security-advisories](https://github.com/nextcloud/security-advisories/discussions)
* Customers: Open a support ticket at [portal.nextcloud.com](https://portal.nextcloud.com)
repo.summary: Calendar attachments of local files are offered to downloaded
